reported_success.quote: we were unable to replicate the original results

notes: Titles verified against supplied references. Original locator p.2 corresponds to printed p.78; acquired PDF has an additional JSTOR cover page. Retained F(14) exactly as printed in original Table 1, without supplying an unprinted numerator df. Replication paper has one multicenter experiment explicitly modeled on original Experiment 2, rather than a separately numbered replication Experiment 2. Selected the first reported two-way ANOVA consistency test to match the original grouped analysis; replication also reports a consistency-only ANOVA F(1, 95) = 0.148, p = 0.702. No conversion performed. Replication primary publisher full HTML was available through web retrieval; cached text is a frozen parsed excerpt covering sections 2–5, including all extracted evidence. Institutional PDF and terminal publisher retrieval returned 403 and were not retried.
